snippet.title: God of War Sons of Sparta - Coming of Age | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
Available on PS5® and PS4® today: https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/god-of-war-sons-of-sparta/

Dive into how the story of God of War Sons of Sparta came to be in our latest behind-the-scenes video featuring key developers from the title who explore the creative process of crafting the game’s narrative journey.
